purpose: M8 regeneration queue for ComfyUI/aaa_texture materials that block terrain visual closure.
operating_policy: OpenTopo and ComfyUI are peer texture-source lanes, not alternatives.
Regenerate priority organic blockers through prompt and variant control before relying on deterministic filtering.
Treat regenerated outputs as candidates until Godot terrain-context close/mid/far captures pass.
Use albedo-only or low-strength detail first; promote normal/detail maps only after terrain review.
shared_gate: aaa_texture.py gate passes at the requested quality preset
2x2 tile sheet has no object-like repetition or visible seam
Blender plane and sphere previews read as material, not objects
M6 source-material noise audit improves against the current blocker
source-stack runtime review passes close, mid, and topdown/iso context
